name: tia_create_block_group
description: Create a PLC block group under an exact parent path; existing groups are never overwritten.

group_name.description: Name for the new block group.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

parent_group_path.description: Exact slash-separated parent block-group path; omit or use an empty string for the root group.
